mask_color_case.gt_pixel_rule: R>100, G>90, B<130 inside fixed ROI, 8-bit RGB

coverage_metric_definitions.gt_alpha: Original final-test RGBA alpha, bicubic resized to render size, then / 255
coverage_metric_definitions.interior_region: 7x7 minimum of GT alpha with zero padding > 0.95 (3-pixel square erosion)
coverage_metric_definitions.aggregation: 100 * arithmetic mean of 50 per-frame fractions; not pooled pixel counts
coverage_metric_definitions.empty_region_behavior: Zero numerator and denominator clamped to 1, returning 0
